description: This is a Java test source file for the PoliciesConditionalHeadersValidator component within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically testing conditional header validation logic related to policies in persistence actors.

classes.name: PoliciesConditionalHeadersValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for validating the behavior of PoliciesConditionalHeadersValidator in various scenarios, including immutability, headers validation success, skip conditions, and failure cases.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the PoliciesConditionalHeadersValidatorProvider class is immutable.

methods.name: doesNotThrowExceptionsIfAllChecksSucceed
methods.description: Verifies that no exceptions are thrown when headers match expected conditions.

methods.name: doesNotThrowExceptionsIfCheckIsSkippedBecauseOfNullAndQuery
methods.description: Ensures validation is skipped for query commands.

methods.name: doesNotThrowExceptionsIfCheckIsSkippedBecauseOfNullAndDelete
methods.description: Ensures validation is skipped for delete commands.

methods.name: doesNotSkipIfEntityTagIsNullAndCategoryIsModify
methods.description: Checks that validation proceeds when EntityTag is null and command category is MODIFY.

methods.name: throwsPolicyPreconditionFailedExceptionWhenIfMatchFails
methods.description: Asserts that the correct exception is thrown when If-Match validation fails.

methods.name: throwsPolicyPreconditionFailedExceptionWhenIfNoneMatchFailsAndCategoryIsNotQuery
methods.description: Asserts exception is thrown when If-None-Match validation fails outside of QUERY category.

methods.name: throwsPolicyPreconditionNotModifiedExceptionWhenIfNoneMatchFailsAndCategoryIsQuery
methods.description: Asserts that a NotModified exception is thrown when If-None-Match validation fails during QUERY.

methods.name: createCommandMock
methods.description: Creates a mock Command object with specified headers and category for testing purposes.

methods.name: assertSkipForCommandCategory
methods.description: Helper to verify that validation is skipped for certain command categories.

methods.name: assertETagHeaderInDre
methods.description: Verifies that the exception contains the expected ETag header.

methods.name: assertPreconditionFailed
methods.description: Validates that a PolicyPreconditionFailedException is thrown with the correct message.

methods.name: assertNotModified
methods.description: Validates that a PolicyPreconditionNotModifiedException is thrown with the correct message.
